items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Metrics API graduates to stable
items.blurb: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes the metrics.k8s.io API to stable ( v1 ). This API provides CPU and memory usage for nodes and Pods, and is the API behind commands such as kubectl top and resource-metrics-based autoscaling.
